_comment: Machine-readable specification of the multi-objective search actually implemented (see J_SPEC.md). Every number here is read by jspec.py; nothing is a free parameter elsewhere.
weights_note: taste/composition/novelty are the legacy values in denovo_recipes.compose(); w_mix=0.4 was fixed a priori equal to w_novel and NOT tuned.

terms.T: mean over components of predicted pleasantness / 100. Predictor: RandomForestRegressor(300 trees, seed 0) on ECFP4 (r=2, 2048 bits) trained on Keller 2016 (n=420). taste_source='oof': known molecules use 5-fold out-of-fold predictions (KFold shuffle seed 0), de novo molecules use the full-data model. taste_source='insample_legacy': all molecules use the full-data model (legacy behaviour; known molecules are then predicted in-sample).
terms.C: mean over components of (#favoured classes - #avoided classes) from composition.py SMARTS classes. favour/avoid = top-5 positive / bottom-5 negative mean-pleasantness lift of the 15 classes over all 420 Keller molecules (min n=5 per class).
terms.N: min over the 6 reference flavors f of (1 - mean over components i of max over odorants r in f of Tanimoto_ECFP4(i, r)). Hard constraint N >= 0.5 on every accepted recipe.
terms.M: learned non-additive mixture term: (100 - max over the 6 reference flavors f of s_hat(R,f)) / 100, where s_hat is the predicted human similarity of blend R to the reference-flavor mixture f from set_RF: RandomForestRegressor(300 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, seed 0) trained on ALL Snitz 2013 + Ravia 2020 human similarity pairs (n=555) with features [angle(mean), |d mean|, |d std|, |d min|, |d max|] over 13 z-scored RDKit descriptors. Higher M = predicted perceptually more distinct from every reference flavor.

pool.known: Keller 2016 molecules with safety.screen verdict OK
pool.denovo: first 40 safe candidates of results/lego_denovo.json (in file order)

initialisation: per restart: sample n_components distinct eligible molecules uniformly; resample up to 100 times until N >= nov_min; if still infeasible the last sample is kept (legacy behaviour; counted and reported as infeasible_init)

optimiser.type: stochastic first-improvement 1-swap hill climbing, independent restarts
optimiser.proposal: pick a uniformly random eligible molecule v and a uniformly random slot k; swap if v not already in the recipe
optimiser.accept: N(candidate) >= nov_min and J(candidate) > J(current) strictly
optimiser.stopping_rule: fixed budget of 500 proposals per restart; no early stopping, no temperature, no tolerance
optimiser.dedupe: restarts converging to the same molecule set are collapsed, so fewer than 5 recipes may be returned
optimiser.ranking: recipes sorted by final J, descending
optimiser.proportions: equal during search; Scheffe ratio optimisation (mixtures.optimize_ratios) is a separate post-hoc step on the top recipe only and is not part of J

rng: numpy default_rng(seed); call order per proposal: choice(eligible) first, then integers(n_components) (matches legacy code evaluation order)
